messages.content: Yes — we ship to Pokhara via our courier partners. Delivery typically takes 3–5 business days; shipping charges are calculated at checkout based on weight and distance. We don't ship internationally. Would you like a link to order or help placing one by phone?
Can I book an appointment to pick up my order tomorrow at 3pm?

We don't take pickup bookings through chat. You can collect from our Balkumari (Lalitpur) store — we're open Mon–Sat 9:00 AM–5:00 PM, so tomorrow (Monday) 3:00 PM falls within store hours. Would you like me to connect you with our team to arrange the pickup? I've also let our team know, so a real person will follow up with you.
Is your honey pure, no added sugar?

Yes — our raw Himalayan honey is pure with no added sugar, preservatives, or artificial coloring. It’s raw honey, so crystallization can occur naturally; storing in a cool, dry place or gently warming the jar will restore its liquid texture. Would you like a link to order or more product details?
What's your return policy if a product arrives damaged?

If a product arrives damaged, please contact us within 48 hours of delivery and include a photo — we’ll issue a full refund or replacement (at our discretion). If you’d like, I can connect you with our team to start the claim.
